briefing: It was a strong risk-on day: the NASDAQ rose 2.3% and the S&P 500 rose 1.6%. Following our rule of putting idle cash to work on strong days, we're using the remaining $645 to open a new position in ANT, the best candidate with full signal confirmation. All seven existing positions stay in place so their profit targets and stop-losses can work as set.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, higher-growth assets such as tech stocks, which is why the NASDAQ often rises more than the broader market. For a disciplined investor, these days are a good time to deploy spare cash into the strongest setups, rather than buying on quiet days just to stay fully invested.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，願意把資金投向較高風險、較高增長的資產，例如科技股，因此納指的升幅往往大於大市。對有紀律的投資者而言，這類日子正是動用閒置資金、買入最強勢標的之好時機，而不是在市況平淡時為了滿倉而勉強入市。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rallied broadly, with the NASDAQ up 2.3% and the S&P 500 up 1.6%, and tech and growth names led the way. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't name a specific catalyst, but the screen points to a broad rally: many names across semiconductors, optical networking, miners and large-cap tech showed new bullish MACD crossovers. When the NASDAQ outpaces the S&P 500 like this, investors are usually favoring higher-growth, higher-risk assets.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面走高，納指升2.3%，標普500指數漲1.6%，科技及成長股領漲。由於今日未有相關新聞標題，無法指明具體催化因素，但從篩選結果可見，半導體、光通訊、礦業以至大型科技股均同步出現MACD黃金交叉，顯示升勢相當廣泛。納指跑贏標普，反映資金明顯偏好高增長、高風險資產，市場情緒轉趨積極。

trades.reasoning: ANT is the only top-scored candidate (100) with all four confirmation signals: RSI 61.5 in the bullish zone, a MACD crossover with a rising histogram, price well above the SMA-20, and a volume surge that suggests institutional buying.
